operations.summary: List platform nodes with explicit inventory order and keyset pagination
operations.description: Requires nodes.read in a platform scope. Search is always evaluated after scope isolation and matches node name or region by case-insensitive literal containment, a full UUID exactly, a canonical display ID prefix, or a normalized IPv4/IPv6 address exactly. platform.admin remains a wildcard permission. Without order, the existing UUID ascending order and cursor remain unchanged. With management_sort_desc, rows use persisted management sort, numeric display ID, then UUID descending; its opaque cursor is bound to the authorized scope and filters. Pages are live reads, not a snapshot.

params.name: status
params.type: string: pending / active / draining / disabled / retired
params.description: Exact admin state filter. Deleting a node removes it, so retired is not accepted here (validation_error); a retired row left by a release before physical deletion is listed without a filter and can be deleted.

params.name: presence
params.description: Effective presence derived from the confirmed PostgreSQL projection and the offline threshold.

params.name: search
params.description: Optional literal node search. Surrounding whitespace is ignored; control characters are rejected.

params.name: order
params.description: Omit for the unchanged UUID-ascending NodeListResponse. Explicit management_sort_desc requests persisted management_settings.sort DESC, numeric display_id DESC, internal UUID DESC and requires an order echo. nodes.read and the current platform scope are checked on every request. In this mode only order, status, presence, search, limit and cursor are accepted; unknown or repeated parameters return validation_error (400). Explicit empty/unknown order or cursor is invalid. Limit is 1..300, default 20. There is no ascending management-sort mode.

params.name: cursor
params.description: With no order, the existing last-node UUID. With management_sort_desc, the exact next_cursor returned for the same scope, status, presence and normalized search. Page size can change. Changing sort/filter/scope requires restarting at the first page. This is live keyset pagination, not a snapshot across concurrent writes. Cursors are untrusted bookmarks, not authorization; changing scope/filter/order returns validation_error.

operations.summary: Update one administrative state across a batch of nodes
operations.description: Requires nodes.manage in a platform scope. The request accepts at most 100 unique node IDs and preserves input order in the response. Nodes are locked in UUID order, successful items and their audits commit in one transaction, and validation or state failures are returned per item. Replaying the same idempotency key with the same normalized request returns the stored result without another revision or audit event. admin_state retired is the batch delete; it follows updateNode. Each deletion runs in its own savepoint, so a node in use fails alone with node_in_use (or node_not_found) and the others are still deleted; a deleted item reports status updated with the last node snapshot. Disabling or draining the last online available node of a node-market supply that still has a normal subscriber fails that item with supply_in_use (with online_available and normal_subscriptions); items are checked in UUID order against the ones applied before them.

responses.description: Ordered per-item results. Successful items are committed even when other items fail validation against current state.

operations.description: Requires nodes.read in the current platform scope. Supply only node_id, repeated once per unique canonical nonzero UUID (1 to 300 identifiers). operations.summary: 批量读取节点本机 TCP 探测事实与当前生效策略
operations.description: Requires a platform principal with nodes.read in the current scope. One read-only repeatable database snapshot covers membership, head/active configuration and probe-only node_metric_latest. Items cover the unique request IDs exactly in request order, with no partial results. Any absent or foreign node returns the same node_monitoring_not_found (404), without leaking sibling facts. Invalid/duplicate/unknown query parameters return validation_error (400); absent session invalid_session (401); non-platform or missing permission permission_denied (403). Unavailable storage or invalid persisted facts return node_monitoring_unavailable (503), not an empty snapshot. The configuration reader checks canonical_schema, canonical_snapshot, canonical bytes and SHA-256; this is no signature claim. It neither locks/creates a stream nor reconciles publications. Policy comes only from active_revision, never the editable head. A disabled policy is a request with no application ACK, not evidence that the node has stopped probing. Samples are actual agent_local_tcp only; host metrics and heartbeats are not probes. Requested HTTP/Ping protocols and distributed monitor groups are not execution proof; an executed pause appears as serving_holds.

params.name: node_id
params.description: 1–300 unique canonical lowercase nonzero UUIDs; no other query keys are accepted.

responses.description: 当前生效配置与实际探测事实；缺失数据保持 null。

fields.description: No stream/head zero is unconfigured. A valid nonzero head without an active revision is not_activated. Only active has policy and activation time. head_revision is at least active_revision; a newer head does not replace active policy. Values beyond 9007199254740991 are rejected as unavailable.

fields.description: Exactly one item for each requested ID in the same order; no foreign or duplicate IDs.

operations.summary: Update node inventory metadata or administrative state
operations.description: Requires nodes.manage in a platform scope. If-Match supplies the expected revision. pending nodes cannot be activated or moved through an intermediate management state; first activation is reserved for the future Gateway CompleteEnrollment contract. disabled to active requires a node-bound consumed enrollment authorization. That authorization records permission to enroll only and does not prove certificate persistence, mTLS connectivity, or completed Gateway enrollment. retired is the delete operation and must be the only field: it physically deletes the node. It is rejected with node_in_use while the current revision of a live line group or a live L2 configuration lists the node, or while the node takes part in a queued or running cache operation or an active CC coordination. In one transaction it revokes the active certificates, writes a node.delete audit event (node ID, display ID, name, addresses, revoked certificate IDs and serial numbers, deleting user, time), and deletes the node row together with every row that only describes the node (certificates, identity, sessions, monitoring samples, deployment receipts, task projections). The response is the last node snapshot with admin_state retired. The Gateway ends the session on its next authorization refresh (at most 30 seconds) and rejects reconnects. The name and the licensed node slot are released at once; running the install command on the same host registers a new pending node, which may reuse the name but never the deleted node ID. Disabling or draining the last online available node (active, online, not isolated, not held) of a node-market supply that still has a normal subscriber is rejected with 409 supply_in_use, error.details {online_available, normal_subscriptions}; a supply already without online nodes is not blocked. Line groups only take nodes of their own region, so changing region is rejected with 409 node_region_in_use while the current revision of a live line group of another region lists the node (remove it from that line group first). When pending to active (initialize) leaves the node without a region and the region catalog has exactly one region, the node is put into that region; with several, the request may name one in region.
